newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Korea Exchange Bank closes HK$ FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Korea Exchange Bank closes HK$ FRCD.

text.p: Korea Exchange Bank Hong Kong Branch's HK$500 million floating rate certificate of deposit issue has been allotted, said lead manager Chase Manhattan Asia.
The 364-days issue was priced at par to float at 30 basis points over one-month Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
The management fee is 7.5 basis points.
Lead manager Chase Manhattan Asia committed HK$115 million. Other lead managers with HK$100 million each are Jardine Fleming and Sakura Finance Asia.
Co-lead managers with HK$50 million each are HSBC Markets and Union Bank of Switzerland.
Co-manager Commonwealth Bank of Australia committed HK$25 million. Other co-managers with HK$20 million each, are BNP, LTCB Asia and Oakreed Financial Services.
The certificates are now free to trade.
